A3 · BRAND NEW WINDOWS. I HAVE NO IDEA HOW. · 1902 E Ewing
“I have no idea how” is the most human line in four minutes
of footage. Protect it, and the old wall telephone beat.
Captions are machine-generated. Read them before you ship.

VERIFY NO SECOND PERSON
The first 30s of the source had another voice off camera.
This cut starts at 0:30 to remove it, which also removes the
consent question. Confirm nobody else is audible or visible.

FASTEST CUT IN THE SET
He is already moving room to room at reel pace, so resist
adding transitions. Punch list reads as work, not brag.
Needs end card and music.
